items.summary: FHWAがApplied Pavement Technology, Inc.と協力協定を結び、西部地域のTribal Technical Assistance Program(TTAP)実施を支援するため$625kを交付。先住部族向け道路技術支援プログラムの運営資金。
items.verbatim: THE FEDERAL HIGHWAY ADMINISTRATION (FHWA) ENTERS INTO THIS COOPERATIVE AGREEMENT (AGREEMENT) WITH APPLIED PAVEMENT TECHNOLOGY, INC. TO ASSIST IN THE DELIVERY OF THE TTAP IN THE WESTERN REGION. THE TTAP IS THE TRIBAL COMPONENT OF THE FHWA LOCAL TECHNICAL ASSISTANCE PROGRAM (LTAP) MANAGED BY FHWAS OFF
